text.p: CenterPoint Properties Corp said it has made a public offering of common stock under a shelf registration statement declared effective by the SEC in January, 1996.

A total of 2,250,000 shares are being sold through Lehman Brothers, A.G. Edwards, Smith Barney, McDonald & Co and Wheat First Butcher Singer. A 30-day overallotment option to purchase an additional 250,000 shares was granted.

The net proceeds of the offering to CenterPoint, after underwriter's discount, will be $67,000,000 before the over-allotment. Proceeds will be used to refund all amounts outstanding under CenterPoint's lines of credit and for certain near term industrial property investments.
CenterPoint is a publicly traded real estate investment trust (REIT).
